description:
Activate Castle Garenbrig's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G} and tapping it, adding eighteen {G} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or to activate abilities of creatures.
Activate Wakeroot Elemental by paying {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}, untapping Castle Garenbrig and causing it to become a 5/5 Elemental creature with haste that's still a land.
Repeat.
